name: filters_toolbar
title: Filters Toolbar
description: Shared look and UI of the listing toolbars (filters_post_projects, hobby_pc_video_games_filters, search): search input, icon Filters button with the active-filter count, chips of the active filters + Clear all, results count, and a <dialog> drawer (right side on desktop, bottom sheet on phones) with the View, Sort and Filters sections. Light / dark mode. Each toolbar keeps its own filtering logic and calls window.filtersToolbar.init(form, ...) for the UI.
